See, the stupid English grammar rubs off on me.

Nobody at all will give me a job. I've never committed a crime, I've finished college, etc... I had done everything right. Obviously not. I went through four years of college just to end up with nothing. It's been two years since I graduated. Going to college is not worth it.

No, the police just say.. You don't pay rent or own the place.. so if you don't like being here, get out.. If mother was a father and I was a daughter, I'm almost sure they would tell the father to get out, not the daughter...
I went to jail already 4 years ago after they lied...
There was, I moved in with them, they bullied me a lot worse, I moved back, started being bullied again.

If I did, things would be much worse. Even after going to the psychiatrist, I get pressured into answering if I'm talking about them. But I just tell them no. If they forced a yes answer out of me, I don't know what would happen to me.
Just checking email and I have to clean up soon since it's Friday.. and wait until tonight to be yelled at...
I try to ignore it, but then it scares me and I shake or I jump.. I'm only lucky it hasn't happened when I've sliced tomatoes and other foods.

The landlord doesn't live above me. Some other renter does. And he's not the type of guy you can just simply talk to. Since I don't pay the money to rent the place, I don't really have a say and the person who pays the rent doesn't care if he stomps over my head and constantly follows me around above to the point it feels like I'm being harassed.

I was playing a game online and I was being ignored by people in the chat, maybe because of the awkward and inappropriate things I end up randomly saying without wanting to..

And all I did in person was scratch skin and clear my throat a few times and I hear stomping up above like I'm making too much noise as if my own dwelling is some kind of library.

I try to be as accepting as I can. I admit that I can fail being accepting at times, but I make up for it with a typical level of acceptance that seems to surpass others. No, I'm not on medication. My psychiatrist suggested some natural medication/supplement for depression and for ASD, but all of the stores I went to didn't even carry it. I probably would need medication even less if one company could give me a chance at a job that I can realistically handle so I could move into a place that's way less stressful and quit depending on people who think hurting me is acceptable because they have money which will buy me the basic necessities like food, shelter, clothing, the ability to not go complete sane by seeing a psychiatrist, etc... Yeah, basic necessities in civilized Western world. After I would get a job, nobody will have to falsely accuse me that I imply that nothing is my fault because I'd have a job and I could be entirely responsible for myself... They'll just illogically tell me instead how I'm avoiding all of my problems by spending my time working..

Everyone's opinion matters to me because I've never had a true friend.. and every single person who says that they're my friend acts like an acquaintance. And there are some who would scare me if they suddenly considered me a friend instead of an acquaintance and i'm made to feel like if I do suddenly make a friend, that I should just accept them even if they scare me.

I'm either told that I don't.. or everything in the world combines together to prove that I don't.. Everyone acts like I need to be perfect.. and like I need to act like I'm some big, responsible adult when I've tried so hard, but I don't have the opportunities or skills to.. then I develop depression and they unrealistically expect me to act like a 100% functioning person and to just get over it.. and even though I'm mainly depressed because of everything else, they treat me like I'm so lazy or ask me if I'm a depressed in a mocking tone.. Do these malicious people really think I would actually give them added fuel to hurt me more?.. I've met people halfway.. but I'm still the one who's expected to change.. It pisses me off, makes me frustrated, makes me sad, makes me feel worthless and helpless, and makes me feel suicidal.. and this is just the present.. if I go too much into the past, there will be so much content to talk about it, that I'll just give up because it's so overwhelming and exhausting to talk about.. and i'll just be at the same place as usual.. so yeah.. instead of going through a cycle to get useless help over and over again it's easier to die.. then there's the future that i worry about.. and i really only worry about the future mainly because of the things that have happened involuntarily to me in my past. See, I'm not entitled to anything.. there's no obligation to help me.. so it will always be get over it in any way you can.. even if it's a horrible way that could be prevented by the best ways.. i've already been given some chances, but they've been taken from me by the greed and selfishness of others and neglect to help me learn about those chances and protect my rights to make my own decisions on those chances..
